values: Code, security, role, live-data and launch-readiness review as of 21 September 2026

The application has a strong production foundation: role controls, quiz filtering, server-side grading, result integrity, teacher scoping, challenge logic, responsive navigation and database performance protections are implemented. The code builds successfully and the result migrations are deployed. Commercial launch is not yet recommended until the administrator password is changed, a real student submission is completed, the intended quiz catalog is published, and critical automated regression tests are added. Analytics and challenge quality cannot be fully judged from live behavior because the database currently has zero results and zero challenges.
